title: Ipon Buffer — Local AI Emergency Savings Planner
description: An AI-assisted emergency-savings app that turns expense notes into user-reviewed budget entries and calculates contributions around essential expenses. Validated with 152 automated tests.
detailedDescription: Developed for the ASEAN Financial Health Challenge’s Emergency Savings track, Ipon Buffer helps people with irregular income plan contributions after accounting for daily essentials and upcoming bills. A locally hosted Qwen3 assistant, integrated through Ollama, converts natural-language expense notes into editable budget drafts. Users review the drafts before they affect the plan; financial calculations remain deterministic. The prototype includes exact monetary calculations, consent controls, and simulated deposits and emergency withdrawals. Validation covered 148 backend tests and 4 frontend tests, alongside browser testing. The project also includes a working demo, pitch deck, and documented AI evaluations.
